policy: Keep the personal fork as origin and ggml-org/llama.cpp as upstream. Pin the LEONES submodule to an explicitly reviewed fork commit; do not auto-advance the gitlink. Daily monitoring reports upstream/fork drift without silently changing the pin.
notes: GitHub API confirmed that the personal fork exists and is writable.
At verification time, fork master and upstream master pointed to the same commit.
The fork was one commit ahead of the previous NEPENTHES upstream pin; comparison reported 1 ahead and 0 behind.
LEONES records the fork as a git submodule (mode 160000), pinned to the verified commit.
No llama.cpp source files were copied into LEONES; the submodule references the fork repository.
No local checkout, build, inference run, or MSI hardware validation was performed.
The first native llama.cpp instrumentation PR is open in the personal fork; it is separate from the upstream-synced submodule pin until reviewed and accepted.
The second stacked llama.cpp PR adds the shared ggml event ABI, generic backend buffer lifecycle, CUDA allocation/OOM/pool/VMM/pinned-host, transfer, synchronization and host dispatch probes.
